name: Mafia
summary: A social deduction game where an informed minority secretly kills and an uninformed majority debates and votes to eliminate them.
rules_text: Each player is secretly assigned a team: Mafia and Villagers, with optional power roles like Seer and Protector. Mafia know each other; Villagers know only counts. Game alternates Night and Day. At Night all eyes closed, moderator asks Mafia to silently choose a victim, then other power roles act. By Day moderator announces who died, all living players discuss, accuse, and vote to eliminate one suspect; majority eliminates. Dead players are out and do not speak. In open setups power role counts are public, in closed they are hidden. Village wins when all Mafia are eliminated. Mafia wins when they reach parity with Villagers or no Village win remains.
rating_reason: Classic hidden-role elimination, fits turn-based talk perfectly
